check_max_heap: check if a given array represents a valid max-heap binary tree
validate_heap_property: validate the max-heap property for an array of integers up to n elements
test_f_gold: test the f_gold function against multiple array inputs to verify heap correctness
refactor_f_gold: refactor the f_gold function to support min-heap validation instead of max-heap
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function that checks max-heap property using parent-child index comparison
